messages:
Noah Reed: Heads-up: we're launching a short enablement sprint for 8 fast-moving onboarding accounts next month. Plan = two 45-min office hours (EMEA + APAC) and one focused migration clinic. Need owners + RSVP process.
Vera Singh: I can cover the EMEA slot Tue 11:00 CET recurring. Prefer a one-question RSVP: 'Primary blocker'.
Liam O'Connor: I'll own the migration clinic (Fri 09:00 PT). Can require RSVP and a short pre-submitted log/snippet.
CS-Ops-Bot: RSVP form created: https://forms.redwood.example/sprint-rsvp. Calendar events: 'Enablement Sprint - EMEA', 'Enablement Sprint - APAC', 'Migration Clinic (Fri PT)'.
Noah Reed: Nice. Quick runbook idea: 5m intros, 25m targeted demo, 15m live triage. Capture next steps in thread and tag owner.
Vera Singh: Add checkbox: 'Renewal within 90d?' to RSVP so we flag priority accounts.
Liam O'Connor: Also request 'Primary environment' (Hosted/Dedicated/Private). Helps prepare troubleshooting steps.
Noah Reed: Great. I'll post the runbook to the CS playbook and share links. Volunteers: please mark conflicts by EOD so we can schedule backups. :thumbsup:
